values.name: Inland transport
values.description: Transport by which goods are moved from or to the frontier, or between inland points.

values.name: At the statistical territory limit
values.description: Point by which the means of transport are presumed to have left the statistical territory of despatch or to have entered the statistical territory of arrival.

values.name: Pre-carriage transport
values.description: Transport by which the goods are moved prior to their main carriage transport.

values.name: At border
values.description: Transport by which goods are moved to the Customs frontier.

values.name: At departure
values.description: Transport by which goods are moved from the place of departure.

values.name: At destination
values.description: Transport by which goods are moved at the place of destination.

values.name: Main carriage - fourth carrier
values.description: The fourth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - fifth carrier
values.description: The fifth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - sixth carrier
values.description: The sixth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - seventh carrier
values.description: The seventh carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - eighth carrier
values.description: The eighth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main-carriage transport
values.description: The primary stage in the movement of cargo from the point of origin to the intended destination.

values.name: Main carriage - first carrier
values.description: The first carrier of the ordered transport when more than one carrier is involved.

values.name: Main carriage - second carrier
values.description: The second carrier of the ordered transport when more than one carrier is involved.

values.name: Main carriage - third carrier
values.description: The third carrier of the ordered transport when more than one carrier is involved.

values.name: Inland waterway transport
values.description: Transport by which goods are moved via an inland body of water.

values.name: Delivery carrier all transport
values.description: Carrier responsible from the point of origin to the final delivery destination.

values.name: Second pre-carriage transport
values.description: Second transport by which the goods are moved prior to their main carriage transport.

values.name: Pre-acceptance transport
values.description: The transport by which the goods are moved to the place of acceptance.

values.name: Second on-carriage transport
values.description: Second transport by which the goods are moved after the main carriage transport.

values.name: Main carriage - ninth carrier
values.description: The ninth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: On-carriage transport
values.description: Transport by which the goods are moved after the main carriage transport.

values.name: Main carriage - tenth carrier
values.description: The tenth carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - eleventh carrier
values.description: The eleventh carrier of the ordered transport.

values.name: Main carriage - twelfth carrier
values.description: The twelfth carrier of the ordered transport.
